test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 30 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘F + C’ means ‘F is sister of C’,

 

‘F – C’ means ‘F is the husband of C’,

 

‘F × C’ means ‘F is the father of C’,

 

‘F ÷ C’ means ‘F is the daughter of C’.

 

If ‘R + T ÷ P × Q’, then what is the relationship of P to R?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Husband
 Father
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: R + T ÷ P × Q

It means: R is the sister of T, T is daughter of P, P is father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/920155715b53e924b8cbb0eefbe4f7bf0d36db91616218322ca8c4ec1475eb45.png] 

So, P is the Father' of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
